title: Close request
purpose: Finish an approved request once nothing more will be allocated or shipped.
summary: Finish an approved request once nothing more will be allocated or shipped. Managers and administrators only.

tasks.title: Clear what blocks closing
steps: Release or put back allocated and picked specimens, and dispatch or cancel draft and packed shipments.

good_to_know: No specimen may be allocated or picked, and no shipment a draft or packed.
The reason is kept in the timeline.

sections.title: Who can use it
paragraphs: Managers and administrators, while the request is approved, no specimen is allocated or picked for it, and no shipment is a draft or packed. It opens in the form dialog over the page you came from; without JavaScript it is a page of its own. Cancel returns without saving.

items.label: Reason
items.description: Required, kept in the timeline and history. Do not enter names, signatures, record numbers, birth dates or contact details of a participant.

sections.title: What happens
paragraphs: If someone changed the record after you opened the form, saving is refused with a message to reload; your entries stay in the form and the next save uses the current version.
